name: Band Overhead Scapular Retraction
description: The band overhead scapular retraction holds a resistance band overhead with arms extended and retracts the shoulder blades toward each other without lowering the arms, training the lower trapezius and rhomboids through the overhead position. It reinforces proper scapular mechanics in the overhead range — essential for safe overhead pressing and injury prevention in athletes who frequently work above shoulder height.

execution.starting_position: Hold a resistance band with both hands wider than shoulder width. Raise arms overhead — band taut across the front. Arms stay extended throughout.
execution.setup_instructions: Use a light band — the focus is on scapular mechanics, not load. Stand tall with a neutral spine.
steps: Step 1: Begin with arms extended overhead, band taut.
Step 2: Without lowering the arms, retract the shoulder blades — squeezing them together.
Step 3: Hold the retracted position for 2 seconds.
Step 4: Protract back to the starting position.
common_mistakes: Lowering the arms to assist retraction — arms must stay overhead
Moving at the elbows rather than the shoulder blades
safety_considerations: Appropriate for all levels as a warm-up or shoulder health tool
Avoid overhead exercises if shoulder impingement is symptomatic
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full scapular protraction to full retraction, arms overhead throughout.
coaching_cues: Arms stay up — blades do the work
Think 'squeeze the pencil between your shoulder blades'
